goal: Production Voice Report Card: an owner-facing section on /settings/voice reporting the five evidenced register traits voice learning inferred from the owner's own draft->edit pairs, with the N-of-5 activation state - deterministic derivation, no new data collection.
non_goals: Dashboard digest/doorway (prototype variant C stays deferred)
New storage or data collection of any kind
Partial traits below the activation threshold
Changes to prompt-path or corpus-selection semantics
user_visible_behavior: New 'Voice Report Card' section below the Brand Voice panel on /settings/voice; follows the location selector on multi-location accounts
Activated (>=5 pairs): each detected register trait renders as a plain-language claim plus one real before->after snippet from the owner's own edits; undetected traits are omitted
Activated with zero detected traits: one honest fallback line over the most recent edit's before->after evidence
Below 5 edited replies: progress dots 'N of 5 edited replies' plus copy that only edited, posted replies count and the card activates on its own; no traits shown
invariants: The card derives from exactly the pairs the prompt path uses (getApprovedResponsePairs) - it never claims a pattern the prompt path is not using
Every rendered claim is backed by a real conforming pair's before->after snippet

Detection bar: pattern holds in a strict majority of applicable pairs AND >=2 conforming pairs; Critical reviews trait exempted to >=1 negative pair (star <=2 via classifySentiment) with claim text scoped to its evidence
All reads scoped by account_id and business_id (app-enforced auth scope)
No LLM calls anywhere in this feature
Raw draft/edit text is never logged
edge_cases: Exactly 4 edited replies -> 4-of-5 progress, no traits
>=5 pairs but zero traits clear the detection bar -> fallback line
No negative pairs in the corpus -> Critical reviews row omitted
Pair with draft identical to edited text -> non-conforming for all heuristics
Location switch on multi-location account re-fetches the card
Malformed locationId -> 400; foreign or archived locationId -> 404
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/app/api/settings/voice/route.ts (auth helpers, jsonResponse shape, locationId scoping)
tests_to_add: returns no traits and editedCount below activation threshold
derives greeting trait only when a strict majority of pairs conform
omits critical-reviews trait when no negative pairs exist
detects critical-reviews trait from a single negative pair with evidence-scoped claim
every detected trait's snippet comes from a conforming pair
returns zero traits with activation when no heuristic clears the bar
reports edited-reply count for the progress state
returns 404 for a location outside the caller's account
returns activation progress for a location below threshold
returns derived traits for an activated location
rollback_plan: Not DB-touching: revert the PR. No flag, no migration, no data written.
observability: Route failures report via reportCaughtError('api/settings/voice/report-card GET') -> Sentry
UI renders a visible error state for the section on fetch failure
How I'd know it broke: Sentry route errors plus the section's error state on /settings/voice
